notes: ABox expansion paired with biology-replace-0015 (penicillin: United Kingdom to Germany): keeps the revision's relation and new object (Germany) and gives it a made-up subject (the antibiotic Norvelacin) in an empty slot, so nothing has to be pushed out. Own questions ask the new value; derived: three 2-hop compositions through it (the capital, a neighbour that shares a border with France, and the official language), each through a checked bridge. The revision treats the country as worked out from the discoverer; for a made-up drug nothing is known of a discoverer, so the edit stands as the fact. Unrelated near asks where penicillin was discovered, the subject the paired revision edits.
